evidence_definitions.static_state_write: Literal write to Entity_NPC+0xB64 in the mapped AI function.

evidence_definitions.runtime_state_animation: State and animation observed together in the historical callback index.
evidence_definitions.state_frame_condition: StateFrame offset appears in the local comparison window.
evidence_definitions.health_condition: HP or MaxHP appears in the local comparison window.
evidence_definitions.invincible_write: A write to +0x3B0 in the mapped AI function.
evidence_definitions.phase_edge: A state write with a nearby state comparison; not yet runtime-verified.
evidence_definitions.boss_edge_mechanism: Heuristic class derived from the target state animation, nearby attack/spawn calls, HP/StateFrame conditions, and exact offline transition evidence.

limitations: A nearby comparison is a candidate condition, not proof of the branch source.
Shared AI functions can serve multiple variants and subtypes.
A state animation is descriptive behavior, not proof of damage or invincibility.
Offline training validation and external live-memory timing are separate evidence.

edge_semantics_summary.evidence_policy: Only exact source-state to target-state transitions observed by the offline original engine are counted as verified. Nearby comparisons remain candidate predicates.
